mostWorthwhile.text: Following the filtered sample through nutrient and water recovery made the kidney's job concrete. The glucose example showed why filtering is followed by recovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward, but the drainage route had already been shown, so the explanation felt repetitive.

surprise.text: I learned that healthy kidneys normally recover almost all filtered glucose.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; each followed either the filtered sample or the assembly of the urinary route.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in continuing to see how another body system connects, although the predictable fittings and repeated route made this chapter less engaging than the filtering sequence.
